notes: Generally available 2026-11-19 on the Interactions API (not the Live API) for real-time interactive world generation: a world is seeded from text, a 16:9 reference image or both and steered live; the output is a streaming 1280x720, 24 fps video with synchronized 48 kHz stereo audio. A session lasts up to 120 seconds; serving regions are the United States, Western Europe and Japan. Paid tier only; no Free tier, Batch, Flex, Priority or context caching. Video output (audio included) is $17.50 per 1M tokens at 240 tokens per frame (5,760 tokens per second), which Google puts at about $0.10 per second.

price_records.billing_note: Paid-tier Standard token rates; no Free tier, Batch, Flex, Priority or caching. Input is $1.50 per 1M tokens for text and the reference image. Video output, with the synchronized 48 kHz stereo audio included, is billed per emitted video output token at 240 tokens per frame (5,760 tokens per second at 24 fps): about $0.10 per second (about $6.05 per minute). Sessions last up to 120 seconds and billing continues until the session is ended.
